messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jane Harper <jane.harper@acmevc.com>
Cc: finance-ops@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Investor packet: ARR sanity check & commit hygiene checklist

Team / Jane —

We need a compact, defensible set of board/investor metrics for next Wednesday's packet. Priority is ARR reconciliation, bookings cadence, and a short narrative on the commit basis. Key asks:

- Laura: can you run the ARR roll-forward and highlight any +/$250k adjustments since last close (by account and reason)? Put the tab in the model and flag anything that requires ops follow-up.
- Vivek: we need the commit buckets (Committed / High-Confidence / Commit-at-risk) with supporting CRM stage logic and last-touch timestamps. Include the expected booking month for each row.
- Marcus: double-check that our quota crediting & EBR-driven expansions are excluded from new bookings. If any overlaps, note them in the notes tab.

Attached: Q2_prep_model_v3.xlsx (initial template) and a short checklist (pipeline_cleanse_notes.pdf). Jane — sharing so you can see how we'll present the reconciliation.

Timeline: please update the model and drop a single-line summary in this thread by EOD Friday (6/12). We will finalize the investor one-pager after that.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Finance & Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Harper <jane.harper@acmevc.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Investor packet: ARR sanity check & commit hygiene checklist

Stephanie —

On it. Quick clarifications before I start:
1) CRM stage mapping: should "Verbal OK" be treated as High-Confidence or Commit-at-risk for the investor narrative? I think for the packet we should treat it as High-Confidence if there's an executed PO or signed SOW expected within 30 days.
2) Do we include renewals in the booking view or show them as separate line item? My preference: show net new vs. renewals as separate columns.

I'll pull the commit matrix from HubSpot and add a small column with the evidence type (PO/Signed email/Sales verbal/Legal in progress). Will push a filtered sheet to the model by EOD Friday.

-Vivek

Subject: Re: Investor packet: ARR sanity check & commit hygiene checklist

Stephanie / all —

I've completed the ARR roll-forward and cleaned the model. Summary of adjustments > $250k:
- ACME Analytics: +$420k (rebill timing correction; original MRR booked in Apr but should have been May)
- BrightCore Systems: -$300k (cancellation of expansion; credit issued)
- Zephyr Labs: +$260k (late-NDA lift; reclassified as committed bookings)

I've uploaded Q2_prep_model_v3.xlsx (sheet "ARR_rollforward") with granular notes on each account and a separate "Adj_Log" tab that points to the evidence (in some cases we have PO, in some only sales confirmation). Also added a small reconciliation pivot and a short PDF note (pipeline_cleanse_notes.pdf) with suggested stage remapping for HubSpot.

Next steps I recommend: Vivek to apply the stage mapping and create the commit buckets; Marcus to run a cross-check vs. revenue recognition calendar for potential timing mismatches.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Stephanie and team —

This looks great and very helpful. Two quick asks from the investor side:
1) Could you provide a one-page cover (executive summary) that states the final ARR, QoQ delta, and the top 3 adjustments with one-line rationale? That will sit at the top of the board packet.
2) For any >$250k adjustments, please include the primary evidence link (PO/email/contract) as part of the adj log. We may follow up with diligence questions if anything looks material.

If you can get the one-pager to us early next week, that would be ideal. Appreciate the crisp prep.

Best,
Jane Harper

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Final action items (EOD Monday, 6/15):
- Laura: move evidence links into the "Adj_Log" for the three >$250k items and mark final statuses.
- Vivek: publish commit bucket export (Committed / High-Confidence / Commit-at-risk) and add a one-line evidence tag per row (PO/Signed SOW/Sales email).
- Marcus: run timing cross-check vs rev recognition calendar and confirm no double-counting in July bookings.
- Stephanie: assemble one-page executive summary (I will draft after your updates) and circulate to Jane and Finance Ops for review.

I'll attach the investor_one_pager.docx in this thread when the draft is ready. Thanks everyone — let's keep the updates terse in thread so I can synthesize.

-Stephanie
